docs.title: ChatNet
docs.text:
ChatNet 提供 ChatArch 通用网络/门户 helper：ping/TCP 扫描、URL 收集和检查、浏览器服务健康检查、服务 URL 处理、浏览器式 session/cookie 状态，以及非 sudo 显式 forward proxy 服务。

ECNU 这类应用层门户逻辑属于 ChatECNU；ChatNet 只保留应用无关的网络基础能力。

docs.title: 常用入口
docs.text:
chatnet --help
chatnet --tree
chatnet --tree-brief
chatnet links --url https://example.com
chatnet proxy autostart print --bind 0.0.0.0 --port 18080 --allow-cidr 172.23.0.0/16 --user chatnet

完整树包含参数签名，简版树保留相同注册命令和用途说明。两者都由 ChatStyle 共享渲染器生成，不输出密码或 token 值。

docs.title: CLI 树
docs.text: ChatNet 使用共享的 chatstyle.add_tree_option() 从 Click 注册表生成真实命令树。chatnet --tree 包含参数签名，chatnet --tree-brief 保留相同节点和说明但省略签名。

docs.title: 完整树
docs.text:
chatnet
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
├── links [--path PATH-VALUE] [--glob GLOBS] [--url URLS] [--filter FILTER-REGEX] [--timeout TIMEOUT]  # Check URLs; reads local paths and sends HTTP requests.
├── ping [--network NETWORK] [--concurrency CONCURRENCY] [--output OUTPUT]  # Scan hosts with ICMP; sends network traffic and may write --output.
├── proxy  # Run explicit proxy helpers; credentials stay masked.
│   ├── autostart  # Create non-sudo user systemd autostart artifacts.
│   │   ├── install [--service-name SERVICE-NAME] [--bind BIND] [--port PORT] [--allow-cidr ALLOW-CIDR] [--user USERNAME] [--env-file ENV-FILE] [--python PYTHON-BIN] [--enable] [--interactive]  # Write a user systemd unit and optionally enable it.
│   │   └── print [--service-name SERVICE-NAME] [--bind BIND] [--port PORT] [--allow-cidr ALLOW-CIDR] [--user USERNAME] [--env-file ENV-FILE] [--python PYTHON-BIN] [--interactive]  # Render a user systemd unit; read-only text output.
│   ├── check [--proxy-url PROXY-URL] [--url TARGET-URL] [--user USERNAME] [--password PASSWORD] [--expect-status EXPECT-STATUS] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--show-body] [--interactive]  # Check a URL via proxy; sends a request and redacts the proxy URL.
│   └── serve [--bind BIND] [--port PORT] [--allow-cidr ALLOW-CIDR] [--user USERNAME] [--password PASSWORD] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--interactive]  # Serve a forward proxy; long-running listener with no secret output.
├── recovery  # Diagnose and recover locally; settings come from ChatEnv.
│   ├── check [--json-output]  # Check the configured link; never change network state.
│   └── run [--execute] [--json-output]  # Plan a recovery, or execute it with safety and budget checks.
├── services [--chromium-url CHROMIUM-URL] [--chromium-token CHROMIUM-TOKEN] [--chromedriver-url CHROMEDRIVER-URL] [--playwright-url PLAYWRIGHT-URL] [--timeout TIMEOUT]  # Check browser services; sends requests and redacts Chromium tokens.
└── ssh [--input INPUT-FILE] [--network NETWORK] [--port PORT] [--concurrency CONCURRENCY] [--output OUTPUT]  # Scan TCP ports; sends network traffic and may write --output.

docs.title: 验收条目
docs.text:
• chatnet --help 必须显示 --tree 和 --tree-brief。
  • chatnet --tree 必须列出 ping、ssh、links、services、proxy serve/check/autostart print/install。
  • chatnet --tree-brief 必须保留相同命令和用途说明，但不显示参数签名。
  • 输出不得包含已迁出的 ecnu 业务命令，也不得包含模板 hello 命令。
  • 密码和 token 只能以选项名出现；值不得写入树或运行摘要。
  • 新增/删除 CLI 命令时，同步更新注册表测试、本页和 README。

docs.title: 离线网络恢复
docs.text: 首版聚焦 Linux + NetworkManager 的一次性诊断与受控恢复。先恢复真实网络、记录可工作的脚本，再按实际复发迭代；不要求首版覆盖所有驱动或故障，也不启动后台监控。

docs.title: 日常命令
docs.text:
chatnet recovery check
chatnet recovery run                 # 预演，不改变网络
chatnet recovery run --execute       # 显式执行一次
chatnet recovery check --json-output

诊断不健康或执行失败时返回非零。链路已健康时，run --execute 不重载驱动。公网探测单点失败但本地网关仍可达，不触发无线恢复。

docs.title: 一次性 ENV 配置
docs.text:
配置归属既有 ChatEnv ChatNet schema；读取顺序为进程环境优先于活动 profile。日常 CLI 不要求网卡、驱动或机器参数。

CHATNET_RECOVERY_INTERFACE=
CHATNET_RECOVERY_CONNECTION=saved-wifi
CHATNET_RECOVERY_RESCUE_PEER=192.0.2.1
CHATNET_RECOVERY_PROBE_HOST=
CHATNET_RECOVERY_MODULE_RELOAD=true
CHATNET_RECOVERY_COOLDOWN=300
CHATNET_RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3
CHATNET_RECOVERY_WINDOW=3600

以上为示例，不是可直接用于当前网络的地址。INTERFACE 留空时要求仅存在一个无线接口；CONNECTION 是已保存连接的名称或 UUID，留空时要求可唯一选择。多个保存连接应显式选定，工具不会猜测。RESCUE_PEER 应是实际可经独立物理有线接口到达的管理对端。MODULE_RELOAD 默认为 false；模块名始终由内核推导，没有任意模块覆盖参数。

不要填写 Wi-Fi 密码：只激活 NetworkManager 已保存的连接，不读取、复制或更改认证资料。使用现有 ChatEnv 工具管理 profile，然后运行 chatenv test -t chatnet -I 验证配置；该验证不修改网络。

docs.title: 恢复路径和保护
docs.text:
1. 诊断目标及当前 SSH 路径；当前 SSH 经目标无线接口时拒绝恢复。
  2. 未开启模块模式时，仅对原保存连接做有界扫描和重连。
  3. 开启模块模式时，要求有独立物理有线救援路径且驱动只绑定一个设备，直接执行已实践过的模块卸载、加载、等待设备就绪、原连接激活路径；不让已知失效的扫描步骤阻挡该路径。
  4. 重新检测网关，不把命令返回 0 当作恢复成功。

执行使用既有非交互 sudo 权限；工具不安装 sudoers、不重启 NetworkManager/主机，不下载驱动或固件。实际模块/权限或连接失败需保留证据，不能宣称已根治硬件问题。

docs.title: 状态与安装边界
docs.text:
$CHATARCH_HOME/envs/ChatNet/       # 既有 ChatEnv profile
$CHATARCH_HOME/chatnet/recovery/  # 锁、预算、执行记录

未设置 CHATARCH_HOME 时使用 ~/.chatarch。执行前持久化恢复预算，默认五分钟冷却、一小时最多三次；状态损坏或时钟回退时停止，不清零预算。日志只保留阶段和结果，不公开原始命令 stderr。安装依赖齐备后，无需源码 checkout 或断网时联网安装。

后台 watch/service 不属于本次首版命令面。Python 调用方可使用 chatnet.recovery.check_recovery()、recover_network(execute=False) 和 recovery_home()。

docs.title: ChatNet
docs.text:
ChatNet provides generic ChatArch network and portal helper primitives: ping/TCP scans, URL collection and checks, browser-service health checks, service URL helpers, browser-like session/cookie state, and non-sudo explicit forward proxy helpers.

Application-level ECNU portal logic belongs in ChatECNU; ChatNet stays application-neutral.

docs.title: Common entrypoints
docs.text:
chatnet --help
chatnet --tree
chatnet --tree-brief
chatnet links --url https://example.com
chatnet proxy autostart print --bind 0.0.0.0 --port 18080 --allow-cidr 172.23.0.0/16 --user chatnet

The full tree includes signatures; the brief tree keeps the same registered commands and purpose summaries. Both use ChatStyle's shared renderer and never print password or token values.

docs.title: Acceptance checklist
docs.text:
• chatnet --help must expose --tree and --tree-brief.
  • chatnet --tree must list ping, ssh, links, services, and nested proxy serve/check/autostart print/install.
  • chatnet --tree-brief must retain the same commands and purpose summaries while omitting signatures.
  • The output must not contain the migrated ecnu application commands or the scaffold hello command.
  • Passwords and tokens may appear only as option names; values must never enter tree output or runtime summaries.
  • When commands are added or removed, update registry tests, this page, and README together.

docs.title: Offline network recovery
docs.text:
The first version provides one-shot diagnosis and guarded recovery on Linux with NetworkManager. Restore the real connection first, record the working procedure, then improve the CLI from observed incidents. It does not start a watchdog or claim to handle every driver failure.

chatnet recovery check
chatnet recovery run                 # read-only plan
chatnet recovery run --execute       # explicitly execute one attempt
chatnet recovery check --json-output

An unhealthy check or failed recovery exits nonzero. A healthy link is not reset. Failure of an optional external probe does not trigger a repair when the local gateway remains reachable.

docs.title: ChatEnv configuration
docs.text:
Use the existing ChatNet provider. Process environment overrides the active profile; hardware options do not belong in daily CLI arguments.

CHATNET_RECOVERY_INTERFACE=
CHATNET_RECOVERY_CONNECTION=saved-wifi
CHATNET_RECOVERY_RESCUE_PEER=192.0.2.1
CHATNET_RECOVERY_PROBE_HOST=
CHATNET_RECOVERY_MODULE_RELOAD=true
CHATNET_RECOVERY_COOLDOWN=300
CHATNET_RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3
CHATNET_RECOVERY_WINDOW=3600

Replace the example connection/peer with verified local values. An empty interface requires exactly one wireless interface. An empty connection requires an unambiguous saved Wi-Fi profile. Module reload defaults to false; the module is derived from the kernel and cannot be overridden. The rescue peer must route through an independent physical Ethernet interface with carrier.

Do not provide Wi-Fi passwords: existing NetworkManager authentication is reused unchanged. Manage the profile through ChatEnv, then run chatenv test -t chatnet -I for configuration validation without network mutations.

docs.title: Guarded recovery
docs.text:
The command protects the foreground SSH path. With module mode disabled it only attempts bounded scanning/reconnection. Explicit module mode requires a physical wired rescue path and a driver bound to exactly one device, then directly follows the proven sequence: module unload, module load, device settlement, and activation of the saved connection. A failed scan is not a prerequisite for that path. A fresh gateway check determines success.

Existing noninteractive sudo permissions are required for execution. The package does not install sudoers, restart NetworkManager/the host, replace firmware, or download dependencies during recovery. Recovery is mitigation, not proof of a permanent hardware fix.

Profiles remain in $CHATARCH_HOME/envs/ChatNet/; locks, budgets and metadata-only logs use $CHATARCH_HOME/chatnet/recovery/. The default home is ~/.chatarch. Budgets are persisted before mutation: five-minute cooldown and at most three attempts per hour by default. Corrupt state or a regressed clock fails closed. Raw command stderr is not published.

The installed package does not depend on a source checkout. Background watch/service commands are outside this first version. Python callers can use chatnet.recovery.check_recovery(), recover_network(execute=False) and recovery_home().
